STORMFALL

Drop onto Thornwick Island, loot the chests, chop wood, build fast, and stay ahead of the storm. One walks away.

Edit your piece: G, click or drag across tiles, G again or let go to confirm; right-click resets it. Drag across stairs to turn themG or F

Look without a mouseArrow keys

Harvest with the pickaxe (slot 1): trees and crates give wood, rocks give brick, barrels give metal. Every piece costs 10; right-click in build mode to switch material (metal is toughest).
